display_name: Anandhan of the Manigramam & Yosef of the Anjuvannam
one_line: Two merchant-leaders witnessing the 849 CE Kollam copper-plate charter on the Kerala coast, representing Manigramam and Anjuvannam guilds.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but sturdy trader builds, used to sea travel and port life.
appearance.face: Both have oval faces with medium-brown Kerala complexions; Anandhan has a straight nose, neatly kept short beard and calm, observant eyes; Yosef has a slightly aquiline nose, trimmed beard, and sharp, calculating gaze; default expressions are serious yet approachable, focused on negotiation.
appearance.hair: Anandhan’s black hair is tied back in a low knot at the nape, with a narrow white cotton headband; Yosef’s dark brown, slightly wavy hair is mostly covered by a simple dark-blue cloth cap, fitted like a soft skullcap, with short hair visible at the sides.
appearance.costume: Anandhan wears a knee-length off-white cotton mundu wrapped firmly at the waist with a narrow reddish-brown border, a light cream long-sleeved cotton angarkha-style upper cloth crossing left over right and tied with fabric ties, and a thin gold waist-chain peeking at the knot; over his left shoulder lies a plain, unpatterned light-ochre cotton shawl; he has simple gold ear-studs, a thin gold bangle on one wrist, and leather sandals. Yosef wears a calf-length, straight-cut off-white linen tunic with long, slightly narrow sleeves and a modest round neckline slit at the front, belted with a dark brown leather belt; over it he wraps a deep-blue woolen cloak draped over one shoulder and across the chest, pinned near the collarbone, with the inner lining a muted reddish-brown; his lower garment is a plain, slightly darker off-white woven cloth visible below the tunic, and his sandals are dark leather; he wears a small simple bronze pendant on a cord under the tunic and a plain bronze ring.
appearance.signature: A single rolled copper-plate charter tied with a red-brown cord that they hold together—Anandhan gripping the lower part with one hand, Yosef steadying the upper part—with faint etched script lines visible on the copper surface.

ref_desc: Two lean, medium-brown men—Anandhan with back-tied black hair, cream angarkha and off-white mundu, and Yosef in an off-white tunic, deep-blue cloak and cloth cap—stand together holding a rolled copper-plate charter, using off-white, cream, light ochre, deep blue and reddish-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two merchant-leaders in 9th-century Kollam, Kerala: first, Anandhan, a lean medium-brown man with an oval face, short beard, calm eyes and black hair tied in a low knot with a narrow white headband, wearing a knee-length off-white cotton mundu with a narrow reddish-brown border, a light cream long-sleeved angarkha-style upper cloth crossing left over right and tied at the side, a thin gold waist-chain, a plain light-ochre cotton shawl over his left shoulder, simple gold ear-studs, a thin gold bangle and leather sandals; second, Yosef, a slightly leaner medium-brown man with an oval face, aquiline nose, trimmed beard, sharp eyes and dark-brown slightly wavy hair mostly covered by a simple dark-blue cloth skullcap, wearing a calf-length off-white linen tunic with long sleeves and a modest round neckline slit, belted with a dark brown leather belt, a deep-blue woolen cloak draped over one shoulder with a muted reddish-brown lining, a plain off-white lower garment visible beneath, dark leather sandals, and a small bronze pendant and ring; have them stand side by side, both fully and modestly clothed, holding together a rolled copper-plate charter tied with a red-brown cord, its copper surface showing faint etched script, and use a restrained palette of off-white, cream, light ochre, deep blue and reddish-brown for clothing and accents.
